claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Mebeverine is a poorly cytotoxic antispasmodic/antimuscarinic agent that is unlikely to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect a cationic amphiphilic lysosomal/off-target effect rather than CHRM1 antagonism.
